propositions: Bedrock provider ignores AWS_REGION environment variable, the standard region variable set by modern AWS tooling and operator shells, causing all LLM operations to fail with 'no AWS region could be resolved' unless REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is manually set.

Region resolution follows a deterministic precedence chain: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION (config) > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (env) > AWS_REGION (env) > boto3 profile fallback, with explicit passing to boto3.session.Session() to bypass botocore's AWS_REGION quirk.

Provider provenance records region and region_source fields verbatim when bedrock's resolution chain succeeds; both fields are absent when ambient boto3 profile resolution applies or for non-bedrock providers.

Resolution error message documents the full precedence chain (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION, profile) and removes outdated guidance claiming AWS_REGION alone does not resolve.
